detail.longDescription: 🤔 German-Japanese researchers invent electricity-free tech that could cool datacenters ｢ Researchers from the Karlsruhe Institute of Technology and the University of Tsukuba published a paper in Nature Energy on Friday discussing the success they had with a solid-state cooling technology that doesn’t need any electric input at all, and was still able to demonstrate temperature reductions in laboratory experiments ｣ https://www. theregister.com/science/2026/0 8/28/german-japanese-researchers-invent-electricity-free-tech-that-could-cool-datacenters/5293364 # datacenters # AI # cooling # science # research
